Message:
wifi: brcmfmac: Remove unused brcmf_cfg80211_get_iftype()

brcmf_cfg80211_get_iftype() has been unused since 2013's commit
5cd51c2bad56 ("brcmfmac: Find correct MAC descriptor in case of TDLS.")

Remove it.
